ST_FullNames.LOC_FN_sLevelDefault_LEVEL0_F: The results of hard work and dedication always look like luck. But you know you've earned every ounce of your success.
ST_FullNames.LOC_FN_sLevelDoneWarning_LEVEL0_F: You need to finish distributing attribute points before leaving.
ST_FullNames.LOC_FN_sLevelUp11_LEVEL0_F: Being smart doesn't hurt. And a little luck now and then is nice. But the key is patience and hard work.
ST_FullNames.LOC_FN_sLevelUp12_LEVEL0_F: You can't believe how easy it is. You just have to go... a little crazy. And then, suddenly, it all makes sense, and everything you do turns to gold.
ST_FullNames.LOC_FN_sLevelUp15_LEVEL0_F: Now you just stay at your peak as long as you can. There's no one stronger in Tamriel, but there's always someone younger... a new challenger.
ST_FullNames.LOC_FN_sLevelUp17_LEVEL0_F: Life isn't over. You can still get smarter, or cleverer, or more experienced, or meaner... but your body and soul just aren't going to get any younger.
ST_FullNames.LOC_FN_sLevelUp18_LEVEL0_F: With the life you've been living, the punishment your body has taken... there are limits, and maybe you've reached them. Is this what it's like to grow old?
ST_FullNames.LOC_FN_sLevelUp19_LEVEL0_F: You're really good. Maybe the best. And that's why it's so hard to get better. But you just keep trying, because that's the way you are.
ST_FullNames.LOC_FN_sLevelUp20_LEVEL0_F: By superhuman effort, you can avoid slipping backwards for a while. But one day, you'll lose a step, or drop a beat, or miss a detail... and you'll be gone forever.
ST_FullNames.LOC_FN_sLevelUp4_LEVEL0_F: You've done things the hard way. But without taking risks, taking responsibility for failure... how could you have understood?
ST_FullNames.LOC_FN_sLevelUp6_LEVEL0_F: You've learned a lot about Cyrodiil... and about yourself. It's hard to believe how ignorant you were, but now you have so much more to learn.
